result.title: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
result.summary: Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student's interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio--video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Simplified Matching Distillation（SMD），用简单的 on-policy velocity 回归蒸馏少步扩散/流模型，并引入训练期残差代理 Pivot，把局部修正与学生的区间均值预测分离，同时排斥较弱教师预测，从而在无需辅助 score 模型与对抗训练的情况下实现 4-NFE 生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 on-policy 蒸馏与「局部修正＋区间均值」的残差分解属于训练期逐步监督机制，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的步级贡献分配与监督提供线索；但研究对象是扩散生成而非多模态推理，迁移可行性需人工核查。
